name: @six5536/tramlines-workspace
description: tramlines: checks documents against a schema, shipped as prebuilt binaries for npm and crates.io.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:linux-x64 && npm run build:linux-arm64 && npm run build:darwin-x64 && npm run build:darwin-arm64
scripts.build:linux-x64: rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl -p tramlines && install -m 0755 target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/tramlines packages/tramlines-linux-x64/bin/tramlines
scripts.build:linux-arm64: rustup target add aarch64-unknown-linux-musl && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl -p tramlines && install -m 0755 target/aarch64-unknown-linux-musl/release/tramlines packages/tramlines-linux-arm64/bin/tramlines
scripts.build:darwin-x64: rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin -p tramlines && install -m 0755 target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/tramlines packages/tramlines-darwin-x64/bin/tramlines
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin -p tramlines && install -m 0755 target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/tramlines packages/tramlines-darwin-arm64/bin/tramlines
